tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. Validates the Brevo API key against GET /account.

tools.name: send-transactional-email
tools.description: Send a transactional email via Brevo (POST /smtp/email). Returns { messageId, subject, sender, recipients, recipientCount }. The sender email MUST be a verified sender or domain in the Brevo account. Provide htmlContent and/or textContent (at least one). Params: sender{email,name?}, to[{email,name?}] (≥1), subject, htmlContent?, textContent?, cc?, bcc?, replyTo{email,name?}?, params? (template variables), tags?.

htmlContent.description: HTML body. At least one of htmlContent / textContent is required.

textContent.description: Plain-text body. At least one of htmlContent / textContent is required.

cc.description: Optional CC recipients. Each { email (required), name? }.

bcc.description: Optional BCC recipients. Each { email (required), name? }.

params.description: Optional template variables substituted in the content (e.g. { FNAME: "Ana" }).

tools.name: list-contacts
tools.description: List contacts from Brevo (GET /contacts). Returns { contacts:[{id,email,emailBlacklisted,smsBlacklisted,listIds,attributes,createdAt,modifiedAt}], count, limit, offset }. Params: limit? (1-1000, default 50), offset? (default 0).

offset.description: Index of the first contact for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: create-contact
tools.description: Create (or update) a contact in Brevo (POST /contacts). Returns { id, email, listIds, updated }. Set updateEnabled:true to update an existing contact instead of failing on a duplicate. Params: email (required), attributes? (e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, SMS }), listIds? (number[]), updateEnabled? (default false).

attributes.description: Contact attributes keyed by Brevo attribute name (e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, SMS }).

listIds.description: Brevo list ids to add the contact to.

updateEnabled.description: If true, update the contact when it already exists instead of erroring (default false).

tools.name: get-contact
tools.description: Get one contact by email or id from Brevo (GET /contacts/{identifier}). Returns { id, email, emailBlacklisted, smsBlacklisted, listIds, attributes, createdAt, modifiedAt }. Params: identifier (required — the contact email or id).

identifier.description: The contact email or numeric id (required).

tools.name: update-contact
tools.description: Update a contact in Brevo (PUT /contacts/{identifier}). Returns { identifier, updated, listIds, unlinkListIds }. Attributes must already exist in the account (pass them UPPERCASE). listIds adds the contact to lists, unlinkListIds removes it. Params: identifier (required — email or id), attributes? (e.g. { FIRSTNAME }), emailBlacklisted?, smsBlacklisted?, listIds? (number[]), unlinkListIds? (number[]).

identifier.description: The contact email or numeric id to update (required).

attributes.description: Attributes to set (must already exist in the account, UPPERCASE, e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME }).

emailBlacklisted.description: Blacklist (true) or allow (false) the contact for emails.

smsBlacklisted.description: Blacklist (true) or allow (false) the contact for SMS.

listIds.description: List ids to add the contact to.

unlinkListIds.description: List ids to remove the contact from.

tools.name: delete-contact
tools.description: Delete a contact permanently from Brevo (DELETE /contacts/{identifier}). IRREVERSIBLE — the contact and its history are removed. Returns { identifier, deleted }. Params: identifier (required — the contact email or id).

identifier.description: The contact email or numeric id to delete (required).

tools.name: add-contact-to-list
tools.description: Add contacts to a Brevo list (POST /contacts/lists/{listId}/contacts/add). Identify contacts by emails[] and/or ids[]. Returns { listId, success, failure } (contacts that were / were not added). Params: listId (required, integer), emails? (string[]), ids? (number[]).

tools.name: remove-contact-from-list
tools.description: Remove contacts from a Brevo list (POST /contacts/lists/{listId}/contacts/remove). Identify contacts by emails[] and/or ids[]. Returns { listId, success, failure } (contacts that were / were not removed). Params: listId (required, integer), emails? (string[]), ids? (number[]).

tools.name: import-contacts
tools.description: Bulk-import contacts into Brevo lists (POST /contacts/import). Provide EITHER jsonBody[] (inline contacts) OR fileUrl (a .csv/.json/.txt file), never both. Runs asynchronously — returns { processId, listIds, contactCount, source }. Params: jsonBody? ([{ email (required), attributes? }]), fileUrl? (http(s) URL), listIds (required, integer[] — the target lists), updateExistingContacts? (default false — update contacts that already exist instead of skipping them).

jsonBody.description: Inline contacts to import (mutually exclusive with fileUrl).

attributes.description: Contact attributes keyed by Brevo attribute name (e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME }).

fileUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of a .csv/.json/.txt file to import (mutually exclusive with jsonBody).

listIds.description: Ids of the lists the contacts are imported into (required, at least one).

updateExistingContacts.description: If true, update contacts that already exist instead of skipping them (default false).

tools.name: list-attributes
tools.description: List the contact attributes defined in the Brevo account (GET /contacts/attributes). Use it to discover valid attribute keys (e.g. FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, custom fields) before creating/updating/importing contacts. Returns { attributes:[{name,category,type}], count }. No params.

tools.name: list-segments
tools.description: List the contact segments (saved filters) in the Brevo account (GET /contacts/segments). Their ids can be used as recipients.segmentIds in create-email-campaign. Returns { segments:[{id,segmentName,categoryName,updatedAt}], count, limit, offset, sort }. Params: limit? (1-50, default 10), offset? (default 0), sort? (asc | desc — by creation date, default desc).

offset.description: Index of the first segment for pagination (default 0).

sort.description: Sort by record creation: asc or desc (default desc).

tools.name: list-folders
tools.description: List contact folders from Brevo (GET /contacts/folders). Folders group contact lists; a folderId is required to create a list, so use this to discover one. Returns { folders:[{id,name,totalSubscribers,uniqueSubscribers,totalBlacklisted}], count, limit, offset }. Params: limit? (1-50, default 50), offset? (default 0).

offset.description: Index of the first folder for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: list-lists
tools.description: List contact lists from Brevo (GET /contacts/lists). Returns { lists:[{id,name,folderId,totalSubscribers,uniqueSubscribers,totalBlacklisted}], count, limit, offset }. Params: limit? (1-50, default 50), offset? (default 0).

offset.description: Index of the first list for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: create-list
tools.description: Create a contact list in Brevo (POST /contacts/lists). Returns { id, name, folderId }. Lists live inside a folder — pass a folderId (call list-folders to find one). Params: name (required), folderId (required, integer).

folderId.description: Id of the parent folder (required). Use list-folders to find one.

tools.name: list-email-templates
tools.description: List transactional email templates from Brevo (GET /smtp/templates). Returns { templates:[{id,name,subject,isActive,testSent,sender,replyTo,toField,tag,createdAt,modifiedAt}], count, templateStatus, limit, offset }. Params: templateStatus? (true=active only, false=inactive only, omit for all), limit? (1-1000, default 50), offset? (default 0).

templateStatus.description: Filter by status: true=active only, false=inactive only. Omit to return all.

offset.description: Index of the first template for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: create-email-template
tools.description: Create a transactional email template in Brevo (POST /smtp/templates). Returns { id, templateName, subject, isActive }. Templates are INACTIVE by default — set isActive:true to enable. sender takes EITHER {email} (a verified sender) OR {id} (a Brevo sender id), not both. Provide htmlContent (≥10 chars) or htmlUrl. Params: templateName (required), subject (required), sender{email?,id?,name?} (required), htmlContent?, htmlUrl?, isActive?, replyTo?, toField?, tag?, attachmentUrl?.

sender.description: Sender — EITHER { email } (a verified sender) OR { id } (a Brevo sender id), not both. Optional name.

htmlContent.description: HTML body (at least 10 characters). Provide this or htmlUrl.

htmlUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL whose content is the HTML body. Provide this or htmlContent.

isActive.description: Whether the template is active (default false — inactive).

toField.description: Optional personalization of the To field (e.g. {{contact.FNAME}} {{contact.LNAME}}).

attachmentUrl.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL of an attachment.

tools.name: list-email-campaigns
tools.description: List email campaigns from Brevo (GET /emailCampaigns). Returns { campaigns:[{id,name,subject,type,status,scheduledAt,createdAt,modifiedAt}], count, type, status, limit, offset }. Params: type? (classic|trigger), status? (draft|sent|archive|queued|suspended|inProcess), limit? (1-100, default 50), offset? (default 0).

offset.description: Index of the first campaign for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: get-email-campaign
tools.description: Get one email campaign by id from Brevo (GET /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}). Returns { id, name, subject, type, status, scheduledAt, createdAt, modifiedAt }. Params: campaignId (required, integer).

tools.name: create-email-campaign
tools.description: Create an email campaign (newsletter) in Brevo (POST /emailCampaigns). Returns { id, name, subject, scheduledAt }. Provide content via EXACTLY ONE of htmlContent (≥10 chars), htmlUrl or templateId. sender is { email } XOR { id }. Add recipients{listIds} to target lists; if scheduledAt (ISO 8601) is set, listIds is required. Without scheduledAt the campaign is a draft you send later with send-email-campaign. Params: name (required), subject (required), sender{email?,id?,name?} (required), htmlContent?, htmlUrl?, templateId?, recipients{listIds?,exclusionListIds?,segmentIds?}?, scheduledAt?, replyTo?, toField?, tag?, previewText?.

sender.description: Sender — EITHER { email } (verified) OR { id }, not both. Optional name.

htmlContent.description: HTML body (≥10 chars). Provide exactly one of htmlContent, htmlUrl or templateId.

htmlUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the HTML body. Provide exactly one of htmlContent, htmlUrl or templateId.

templateId.description: Id of an active transactional template used as content. Provide exactly one of htmlContent, htmlUrl or templateId.

recipients.description: Who receives the campaign. Required to send; listIds is required when scheduledAt is set.

exclusionListIds.description: List ids to exclude from the send.

segmentIds.description: Segment ids to send to (alternative to listIds).

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 send date-time (e.g. 2026-06-01T12:30:00+02:00). Omit to create a draft sent later with send-email-campaign.

tools.name: send-test-email
tools.description: Send a test of an email campaign to specific addresses (POST /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendTest). Delivers REAL emails to the given testers. Returns { campaignId, emailTo }. Params: campaignId (required, integer), emailTo (required, array of up to 99 email addresses).

campaignId.description: Id of the campaign to test (required).

emailTo.description: Recipients of the test (1-99 email addresses).

tools.name: send-email-campaign
tools.description: Send an email campaign immediately (POST /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}/sendNow). IRREVERSIBLE — delivers to every recipient with no undo. The campaign must be a draft with recipients set. Returns { campaignId, sent }. Params: campaignId (required, integer).

campaignId.description: Id of the campaign to send now (required).

tools.name: get-email-event-report
tools.description: Get transactional email events from Brevo (GET /smtp/statistics/events): per-message delivery events (delivered, opened, clicks, bounces, spam, unsubscribed…). Returns { events:[{date,email,event,messageId,subject,tag,reason,link,from,templateId}], count, limit, offset }. Timeframe: pass days (1-90) OR a startDate+endDate range (YYYY-MM-DD), not both; defaults to the last 30 days. Params: limit? (1-5000, default 100), offset? (default 0), startDate?, endDate?, days?, email?, event? (bounces|hardBounces|softBounces|delivered|spam|requests|opened|clicks|invalid|deferred|blocked|unsubscribed|error|loadedByProxy), messageId?, templateId?, sort? (asc|desc, default desc).

offset.description: Index of the first event for pagination (default 0).

startDate.description: Start of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with endDate; not compatible with days.

endDate.description: End of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with startDate; not compatible with days.

days.description: Number of days in the past incl. today (1-90). Not compatible with startDate/endDate.

email.description: Filter events for a specific recipient email address.

messageId.description: Filter events for a specific messageId.

templateId.description: Filter events for a specific template id.

sort.description: Sort by record creation: asc or desc (default desc).

tools.name: get-aggregated-smtp-report
tools.description: Get aggregated transactional email stats from Brevo (GET /smtp/statistics/aggregatedReport): totals over a timeframe. Returns { range, requests, delivered, opens, uniqueOpens, clicks, uniqueClicks, hardBounces, softBounces, blocked, invalid, spamReports, unsubscribed }. Timeframe: pass days (1-90) OR a startDate+endDate range (YYYY-MM-DD), not both; defaults to the last 90 days. Params: startDate?, endDate?, days?, tag? (filter by email tag).

startDate.description: Start of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with endDate; not compatible with days.

endDate.description: End of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with startDate; not compatible with days.

days.description: Number of days in the past incl. today (1-90). Not compatible with startDate/endDate.

tag.description: Filter the totals for a specific email tag.
